title: baccharis densa
intro: Baccharis densa, commonly known as Coyote Mint or Tall Baccharis, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Baccharis densa include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve coughs, and ease congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
